user_instruction: از این پروژه استفاده کن سیستم امتیاز دهیش و هیچی قرار نیست قاتی بشه با اپلیکیشن خود ما صرفا رابط کاربریش رو نمیخواد زیادی تغییر بدی ولی یه جوری باشه فکر کنن برای میمو هست نه خود اپلیکیشن ینی زیادی تو چشم نزنه
interpretation: only the scoring system; a quiet Mimo-skinned ششمین تب «روتین روزانه», isolated from everything else; MAX still forbidden

rules.rule: Four task types: habit (plus/minus), daily (checkbox + streak), todo (one-shot + checklist), reward (costs currency, no value change).
rules.mimo_mapping: روتین روزانه: عادت / روزانه / کار امروز / پاداش

rules.rule: Default task: priority=1 (Easy), value=0, attribute=str; reward starts at value=10; daily streak starts at 0.
Priority multipliers: Trivial 0.1, Easy 1, Medium 1.5, Hard 2 (per API enum), applied to delta/EXP/GP/HP.
task.value clamped to [MIN_TASK_VALUE=-47.27, MAX_TASK_VALUE=21.27] before delta.
delta = 0.9747 ** clamp(task.value), signed by direction: up=+delta, down=-delta; unchecking reverses the same delta.
Checklist partial credit: daily down and todo up scale delta by completed/total (and by 1/total when shrinking); scores can be split.
exp += round(delta * (1 + INT*0.025) * priority * crit * 6); INT bonus only when positive delta.
gp += ceil(delta * priority * crit * (1 + PER*0.02) * streakBonus); streakBonus = currStreak/100 + 1 (min +1).
rules.mimo_mapping: شمارندهٔ سکهٔ روتین (جدا از سکههای Learn)

rules.rule: On down: hp += delta * (1 - min(CON,100)/250 clamped >=0.1) * priority * 2, result at most -1; hp bounded by MAX_HEALTH=50.
rules.mimo_mapping: نوار سلامت خیلی کم رنگ، بدون RPG

rules.rule: crit chance = 0.03 * (1 + STR/100); crit multiplier = 1.5 + (4*STR)/(STR+200); deterministic predictableRandom(user).
predictableRandom uses a deterministic sin-based seed from user id + task id + date, so scoring is reproducible (no real RNG).
rules.mimo_mapping: منطق قابل تکرار، بدون شانس واقعی

rules.rule: toNextLevel(lvl) = 25*lvl for lvl<5; 150 at lvl=5; round((lvl^2*0.25 + 10*lvl + 139.75)/10)*10 afterwards.
On crossing toNextLevel: level+1, HP restored to 50, XP subtracts threshold, +1 stat point (capped 100).
rules.mimo_mapping: افزایش سطح، بدون بنر پر زرقوبرق

rules.rule: diminishingReturns(bonus,max,halfway=max/2) = max*bonus/(bonus+halfway): higher bonuses saturate.
MP gain on positive delta, capped by statsComputed(user).maxMP; used for skill unlocks (not exposed in Mimo skin).
rules.mimo_mapping: فقط ثبت شده؛ در UI نمیآید

rules.rule: Completing a daily increments its streak; each 21 consecutive days grants an achievement; cron resets streaks for missed dailies.
Perfect Day (all dailies done) grants a buff / achievement; MP buffer = max(10, 0.1*maxMP) * dailyChecked/(dailyDueUnchecked + dailyChecked).
Cron applies missed-daily damage at dayStart (custom dayStart, multiDaysCountAsOneDay=true); HP loss uses same priority scaling.
rules.mimo_mapping: منطق پسزمینه، بدون اعلان پر سر و صدا

rules.rule: Reward task: gp -= value (default 10), no delta/EXP/HP change; value stays constant.
All Habitica-derived rules live ONLY inside data-screen=routine; they are not wired to exam scores, leaderboard XP, Learn coins or lesson progress.
rules.mimo_mapping: هیچی قرار نیست قاتی بشه با اپلیکیشن خود ما

rules.rule: Habitica code is GPL-3.0 and HabitRPG assets/content are CC-BY-NC-SA 3.0; only abstract rules + SHA-256 digests are recorded, no code/assets copied.
Routine tab uses ONLY Mimo tokens (card/button_primary/progress/TextLabel) and extracted Mimo vectors; no pixel art, avatars, RPG icons or new colours/fonts/radii.
rules.mimo_mapping: فکر کنن برای میمو هست، زیادی تو چشم نزنه
